subsystems.name: Nucleon confinement stage
subsystems.role: holds a target nucleus or small cluster of nuclei in one place with the surrounding particles removed.

subsystems.name: Energy driver
subsystems.role: concentrates enormous energy into a volume smaller than an atomic nucleus.

subsystems.name: Beam and field delivery
subsystems.role: puts particles or fields exactly where a nucleon must be added, removed or rearranged.

subsystems.name: Nuclear metrology
subsystems.role: reads out which isotope and nuclear state you have made.

subsystems.name: Product handling and shielding
subsystems.role: contains the intense radiation produced and removes waste heat.

subsystems.name: Sequencing control
subsystems.role: runs a planned series of pulses to reach a chosen nuclear configuration rather than a random mix.

buildSteps.title: Choose the target nuclear configuration
buildSteps.detail: Decide the exact isotope, nuclear state or nucleon arrangement you want, and compute how much energy it takes to reach it from available feedstock.

buildSteps.title: Isolate the feedstock
buildSteps.detail: Prepare a pure, small sample in an ultra-high vacuum so stray atoms cannot interfere with a nuclear-scale operation.

buildSteps.title: Trap and align
buildSteps.detail: Use electric or magnetic fields to hold the target in place to sub-femtometre accuracy — roughly a thousandth of the width of a proton.

buildSteps.title: Deliver extreme energy density
buildSteps.detail: Fire a synchronised, petawatt-class pulse or particle beam that concentrates enough energy in a tiny volume to overcome the strong nuclear force holding nucleons together.

buildSteps.title: Rearrange the nucleons
buildSteps.detail: Sequence pulses so nucleons are added, knocked out or re-bound into the intended configuration — in effect controlled transmutation, not a random collision spray.

buildSteps.title: Let the nucleus settle
buildSteps.detail: Allow the new configuration to cool and reach a stable or long-lived state, because most rearrangements initially leave a nucleus violently excited.

buildSteps.title: Read back and verify
buildSteps.detail: Measure the gamma rays, neutrons and mass of the product to confirm you made exactly what you intended.

buildSteps.title: Repeat at useful rate
buildSteps.detail: Run the whole cycle many times per second, because each operation changes only an atomic nucleus — an unimaginably small quantity of matter.
